SA, BL1, FL1 and ELC are DROPPED on calibration: SA 50 to 60% +5.52pp (n 162); BL1 10 to 20% +6.30pp (n 247) and 50 to 60% -7.63pp (n 135); FL1 10 to 20% +6.07pp (n 243); ELC 50 to 60% -8.75pp (n 209). The band rule was declared before the run and it decides. The design-stage finding (#363: at these sizes it drops a perfectly calibrated model in about 40%, 40% and 22% of seasons) was recorded before the run as changing nothing, and it changes nothing. The four stay in the shadow and may be declared again on 2026/27. Reported, never gated: the closing market beat the candidate in all five leagues, by 0.050 (PD), 0.042 (SA), 0.042 (BL1), 0.026 (FL1) and 0.028 (ELC) of log-loss. This gate certifies better than naive and calibrated. It does not certify an edge on the market. Confirmation as declared: the first 60 PD league games kicking off after this verdict's recorded time, frozen by fixture id; CONFIRMED iff their log-loss is at most ln 3 and below the naive minus 0.010 on the same games. Sixty games is a small sample: a model as good as this run measured can miss it by chance, and a weaker one can pass it. The declaration stands as frozen. Until CONFIRMED, PD is a shadow like the other four: never a Desk call, never an order line.
